# PR #3152: Patch: a new card needs no hand-written row in the Radiant audit, BUILD's must-pass table or the name comments

Closes #3111

## What changed

A card's name comments now come from one command, and BUILD's must-pass row is no longer required. The Radiant audit row is down to the judgment alone. No card, rule, ruling or catalog value changed.

- **`cargo jackioh names [--check]`** (new, `crates/tools/src/names.rs`) writes each card's name from `catalog.json` into four places:
  - the comment beside its id in `card-audio.json5`;
  - the same comment in `card-text.yaml`;
  - the same comment in each `fx/cards/*.json5`;
  - the `Card` cell of the id-keyed rows in `docs/radiant-audit.md`.

  It only rewrites the name on a line that is already an entry. It never adds, removes or reorders an entry, because a stub would pass the gate that asks for a person's judgment. An id that is not in the catalog is an error. `--check` writes nothing, prints `stale <path>` for each stale file and exits 1. I added its row to the `crates/tools/README.md` table.
- **Radiant audit gate** (`crates/cards/tests/cross/radiant_standard.rs`): a card is covered by its legacy row, as before, or by an id-keyed row in a new last section of `docs/radiant-audit.md`. The gate now fails on these:
  - a card with no row;
  - a row with an empty verdict or reasoning;
  - a row whose `Card` cell is not the catalog name;
  - a second row for the same id, or an id that is not in the catalog.

  The R275 test keeps its name and now asserts `audit_gaps(AUDIT)` is empty. The ~800 legacy rows are untouched.
- **BUILD must-pass row dropped.** BUILD.md gets a "Closed (#3111)" note. CLAUDE.md rule 6 and `crates/cards/README.md` §5 now point at the spec §8 row and the card's own tests.
- **`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`** §1 goes from 13 rows to 12, and I rechecked every row reference. The gates block gains `cargo jackioh names --check`, and the "A renamed card" bullet is now "run `cargo jackioh names`".
- Header comments in `card-audio.json5` and `card-text.yaml` and the assertion messages in `voice-lines.test.ts`, `tables.test.ts` and `export_card_text.rs` now point at the command.

## Testing

All of these passed unless noted.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`. I did not run the workspace-wide clippy or the full workspace test suite; the harness does.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --features jackioh-engine/ts`: 494 unit tests plus the integration suites, including `acceptance.rs`, which holds the README table to clap.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards radiant`: 191 passed, the three new `r275_…` tests among them.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check`.
- `cargo jackioh names --check` on the shipped tree: exit 0, no output.
- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then `vitest run` on `voice-lines.test.ts` and `tables.test.ts` (42 passed). `eslint` on those two files printed nothing.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` printed `classify: Internal` and claimed nothing, but my work was uncommitted, so it saw no diff. The harness's own classify run is the real check.
- **Rename proof on the real files.** I temporarily renamed `core-001` in `catalog.json` and added a temporary audit row. `names --check` reported all four files stale, and `names` rewrote one line in each. I then restored `catalog.json` and the audit and re-ran `names`. `names --check` is clean again, and `catalog.json` shows no diff.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Plan departure: the audio header.** The plan said to remove "change the id and the name comment" from "To add a card". Taken literally that drops the id step, so I kept "change the id" and moved only the name comment to the command.
- **Plan departure: the test target.** The plan's `--test cross` does not exist. The tests live in the `cards` target.
- **Name handling.** I write the catalog name as is, with no whitespace collapsing. No catalog name needs it, and `export_card_text.rs` compares names exactly.
- **Where a legacy audit row is renamed.** The legacy audit cells, `tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `census.rs` and BUILD's rows stay hand-edited on a rename of a card older than this change. The last two are out of scope in the issue, and ADDING_CARDS §4 says so. The rejected alternatives were:
  - re-keying the legacy audit rows, because their Base and Radiant cells are historical shorthand and the diff would be huge;
  - generating stub rows, because a stub must not pass a gate;
  - generating BUILD rows, because the card's own tests already prove them.
- **CLAUDE.md rule 6.** I reworded it minimally, because it named BUILD's tables. A person may want different wording.
- **Verdict words.** The new section's text names "Meets", "Raised" and "Designer's word (effect half)", as the plan said, though the legacy rows also use free-form verdicts.

## For the reviewer

- **Audit gate.** `audit_gaps` in `radiant_standard.rs` still counts a legacy `| <index> | <name> |` substring as coverage, so no existing row needed an edit. Check that a card cannot pass the gate with an empty or missing id-keyed row.
- **Audit rewriter.** `rewrite_audit` reads the row cells with `splitn(4, '|')`, so a reasoning that contains `|` survives a rewrite. A unit test covers this.
- **CI scope.** `names.rs` reads files only when the CLI runs, and its tests use inline strings. No Rust test now reads a web file, so `scripts/ci-scope.sh` needs no entry.

# #3111: Patch: a new card needs no hand-written row in the Radiant audit, BUILD's must-pass table or the name comments
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

The game expects hundreds of new cards a month (owner, 2026-11-05), so per-card hand work is the cost that grows fastest. `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §1 still lists 12 places a card touches, and several only restate what `crates/cards/catalog.json` or the card's own tests already say:

- `docs/radiant-audit.md`: one row per card (§1 row 5).
- `BUILD.md`: the card's must-pass row (row 6), which restates the tests in the card's own file.
- The "name in a comment beside its id, in catalog order" lines in `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5`, `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` and `apps/web/src/fx/cards/<set>.json5` (rows 7, 8, 13). A renamed card fails `voice-lines.test.ts` and `export_card_text.rs` until someone edits the comments by hand.

#2581 merged the catalog counts and explicitly left the Radiant audit and BUILD's must-pass rows out of scope. This picks those up.

### What to change

High level; the planner decides the details:

- Where a row only restates data (id, name, catalog order, test names), generate it with a `cargo jackioh` writer (as `export_card_text` already does), or drop the requirement where a test already proves the same thing.
- Where a row carries a person's judgment (a voice line, a motif, the Radiant audit's verdict under R275), keep the judgment hand-written but generate or check the scaffolding around it (id, name comment, order).
- Update `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §1 to match.

Out of scope: the census and the fixture rows (`crates/cards/src/census.rs`, `tests/cross/catalog.rs`). They are kept literal on purpose as the independent proof against SPEC §8 (#108, #2581). Card text in `spec/08-catalog.md` is also out of scope.

### Acceptance

- `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §1 has fewer rows a person writes by hand.
- Renaming a card takes one command, not hand edits to the comment lines.
- A row that carries a judgment is still required: leaving it out still fails its gate.
- The gates in CLAUDE.md's Commands are green, with no change to any card or rule.

### Blocked by, part of

Follows #108 and #2581.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium

No priority

The night bot (bot:build)
